'''Vichy''' is a male NPC apprehended by a [[Latic|Gladiator]] in [[Capitoline Hill City]] for selling fake miracle remedies. 
{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:;Thank goodness he arrived just in time to stop me from buying that knockoff...
:;Yeah, I feel bad for that tourist couple who just bought some fake medicine a few moments ago. I hope nothing bad happens to that poor girl.

: '''Vichy:''' Eww! This creep just licked my face!
:'''Latic:''' What's this...? It's the smell of crime in the air!

==Dialogue==
:'''Vichy''': D-Don't come any closer. The number of muscles, I can't take it...
:'''Latic''': Then speak! Where are the proper documents for this medicine? Why are you selling them without a license?
:'''Vichy''': All right. All right. Just don't come any closer, and don't lick my face either!
:'''Vichy''': I saw that [[Wuli|couple]] from Huanglong taking a rest over there, and that [[Fuling|girl]] looked really weak in particular.
:'''Vichy''': So I mixed juice with water and sold it to them as some cure-all remedy!
:'''Vichy''': Hey, it's only my first time. Just let me go, will ya?
:'''Latic''': Oh, we're going all right! With me!
:'''Vichy''': N-No... Please...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Note==
* The couple mentioned is Wuli and Fuling from {{Quest|Immortal Blaze}}.
